entities.summary: Carl Emil Hansen Ostenfeld was a Danish systematic botanist. He graduated from the University of Copenhagen under professor Eugenius Warming. He was a keeper at the Botanical Museum 1900–1918, when he became professor of botany at the Royal Veterinary and Agricultural University. In 1923, by the early retirement of Raunkiær's, Ostenfeld became professor of botany at the University of Copenhagen and director of the Copenhagen Botanical Garden, both positions held until his death in 1931. He was a member of the Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters and served on the board of directors of the Carlsberg Foundation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ostenfeld's work on plant taxonomy and his role as director of the Copenhagen Botanical Garden contributed to the development of modern botany in Denmark. His research had a significant impact on the field, but its global reach was limited.
